title: Lefschetz recruited for nonlinear group, later moved to Brown

tellings.quote: why was solomon left schetz the great topologist recruited to be involved with louis whitten and to have an entire non-linear group working on mathematics that then gets moved to brown university when i believe that these programs are sunsetted

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, asks on Jesse Michels's podcast why Solomon Lefschetz, a great topologist (a mathematician who studies shapes and spaces), was recruited in the 1950s to work alongside Louis Witten with a whole group doing nonlinear mathematics at the Glenn Martin Company, an aircraft maker. He says that group was later moved to Brown University, which he believes is when such programs were wound down. He raises it as a sign that top minds were quietly put to work on secret gravity or propulsion research.
